Preferred ICT sessions

  • London 02:00–05:00
  • NY AM 08:30–11:00
  • London–NY overlap 08:00–11:00

Session note: New York ET is the reference timezone. IST must be converted dynamically because the offset changes with US daylight saving time.

ICT models & market context

Models: Asian range sweep, Judas + MSS, Order Block, Breaker, OTE, AMD / PO3

Drivers: US real yields, US Dollar / DX, Fed expectations, Central-bank gold demand, Geopolitical risk, Gold–Silver relative strength

News catalysts: CPI, PPI, NFP, PCE, FOMC, Treasury yields, Geopolitics, Central-bank gold demand

Map Daily/4H structure, PDH/PDL and premium/discount. Mark Asian high/low; a London sweep followed by 15M displacement/MSS can frame a 5M FVG/OB pullback. Also monitor DX and Treasury-yield context.

Related markets: SI, DX, ZN, NQ

Comparison discipline: GC–SI comparison; DX and ZN are macro context, not mechanical signals.

Risk note

Gold can produce large stop hunts and news spikes. Keep the structural stop and reduce size; do not compress the stop just to increase size.

Use the interactive risk calculator and round contract count down. Margin, fees and slippage are broker/provider-specific and are not included in the reference specification table.
